title: Backward Conformal Prediction under Covariate Shift
abstract: arXiv:2610.16048v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Backward conformal prediction (BCP) fixes the size of a prediction set and estimates its miscoverage, but assumes calibration and test data are exchangeable. We extend BCP to covariate shift through importance weighting, preserving its guarantees when the density ratio is known. We show that BCP's tight miscoverage report depends only on the relative weight assigned to missed calibration examples, explaining why a better domain classifier can sometimes produce a worse estimate. Motivated by the fact that BCP depends only on nonconformity scores, we propose estimating density ratios on sorted score vectors rather than high-dimensional inputs. We prove that this approach recovers the same report asymptotically under an interpretable condition and characterize the resulting bias otherwise. translated_title: 协变量偏移下的反向保形预测
translated_abstract: 反向保形预测（BCP）固定预测集的大小并估计其失覆盖率，但其假设校准数据与测试数据是可交换的。我们通过重要性加权将BCP扩展到协变量偏移情形，并在密度比已知时保持其理论保证。我们证明了BCP给出的紧凑失覆盖率报告仅取决于分配给未被覆盖的校准样本的相对权重，这解释了为什么更好的域分类器有时反而会产生更差的估计。受BCP仅依赖于非一致性分数这一事实的启发，我们提出在排序后的分数向量上估计密度比，而非在高维输入上进行估计。我们证明在可解释的条件下，该方法能够渐近地恢复相同的报告，并在不满足该条件时刻画了由此产生的偏差。在模拟分布偏移和基准分布偏移上的实验表明，所提出的方法改进了BCP的失覆盖率估计，同时基于分数的加权方法……
tldr: 该论文通过重要性加权将反向保形预测（BCP）扩展到协变量偏移情形，并提出在排序后的非一致性分数向量而非高维输入上估计密度比，从而在保持理论保证的同时显著改进了失覆盖率的估计效果。
en_tdlr: This paper extends backward conformal prediction (BCP) to covariate shift via importance weighting and proposes estimating density ratios on sorted nonconformity score vectors rather than high-dimensional inputs, improving miscoverage estimates while preserving theoretical guarantees.
